appearance_facts.fact: Selected High-Growth Quarters: Ad Spend vs Sales
Five blue points labeled Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6 form a clear upward diagonal from lower-left to upper-right.
Q2 is lowest-left, Q3 next, Q4 middle, Q5 upper-right, Q6 highest-right.
Horizontal axis increases left-to-right; vertical axis increases bottom-to-top.
Each successive quarter label sits to the right and above the previous one.
